card.title: PANZER III-H
card.text: Deployment: Choose and draw a card from the top 3 of your deck, put rest on bottom.
card.flavorText: The Panzer III-H was a German medium tank in service during WWII and one of many variants in the Panzerkampfwagen III series, a German light tank that was used by the Axis from 1939 to 1945. The Panzer III-H came into service in 1941, it was manned by a crew of 5 (commander, gunner, loader, driver, radio operator/machine gunner), a main armament of a 5 cm KwK 38 L/42 and a secondary armament of 2-3 x  7.92 mm machine guns. A total of 5,774 Panzer III tanks were built from 1939 to 1943, with approximately 286 of them being of the H variant.
